caseName: Heinze v. Butte & Boston Consolidated Mining Co.
caseNameFull: F. Augustus Heinze v. Butte and Boston Consolidated Mining Company

opinions.text: April 11,1904. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied. Mr. John J. McHatton for petitioners. Mr. James W. Beck and Mr. John A. Garver for respondent.
